senses: to think, plan, esteem, calculate, invent, make a judgment, imagine, count
to be accounted, be thought, be esteemed
to think upon, consider, be mindful of
to think to do, devise, plan

strongs.def: properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute
strongs.kjv: (make) account (of), conceive, consider, count, cunning (man, work, workman), devise, esteem, find out, forecast, hold, imagine, impute, invent, be like, mean, purpose, reckon(-ing be made), regard, think
